groups.problem: FallbackLocaleList#[] calls to_sym on a potentially nil default_locale before compact can remove it.
groups.rationale: Both suggestions identify the same unguarded conversion and resulting exception, and propose guarding the value before conversion.

groups.problem: Translations outside ApplicationController#set_locale do not ensure fallback locales are loaded.
groups.rationale: Both identify controller-only fallback preloading while translate loads only the current locale. Loading the fallback chain within the translation path addresses both reports; S9's cached missing result is a consequence of this same problem.

problems: An unguarded default_locale.to_sym can raise when default_locale is nil.
Mixed string and symbol locale values defeat deduplication and loaded-locale checks, causing redundant loads.
uncoveredProblems: Mixed string and symbol locale values cause redundant loads; S8 also reports this, but there are not two single-problem suggestions to form a group.
